spans.s:
n. (-न्दं)
The belly.
f. (-न्दी)
The navel: see तुण्डि.
E.
तुद to torment, क affix, and नुम् augment.

f. (-पी)
The navel.
E.
तुन्द the belly, and कूप a pit, a well, dim. affix ङीष्; also with कन् added तुन्दकूर्पिका, f. (-का.)

m. (-र्जः)
A lazy man, a sloth, a sluggard: see the next.

m. (-जः)
A lazy man, a sluggard.
E.
तुन्द the belly, मृज to rub, with परि prefixed, and क affix; also with the affix घञ्, तुन्दपरिमार्ज as above; passing his whole time in stroking his sides.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Corpulent, fat.
E.
तुन्द, and मतुप् aff. also from तुन्दि, तुन्दिवत्.

n. (-न्दि)
The belly.
f. (-न्दिः)
The navel.
m. (-न्दिः)
One of the Gandharbas or quiristers of Svarga.
E.
तुद to vex or harass, affix इन्, and नुम् inserted.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Having a large or prominent navel, fat, corpulent.
f. (-का)
The navel.
E.
तुन्दी the navel, कन् affix, or तुन्द with ठन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Having a large or prominent navel.
E.
तुन्द with इतच् affix; also तुन्दिक, तुन्दिल, &c.

mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि)
Having a large or prominent navel.
E.
तुन्द with इनि affix; also तुन्दिक, &c.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Tormented, vexed, injured.
2 Cut, broken, cut down, &c.
m. (-न्नः)
Toon or Tuna, a tree of which the wood bears some resemblance to mahogany, and is used for furniture, &c. (Cedrela tunna.)
E.
तुद to vex, affix क्त.

m. (-यः)
A tailor.
E.
तुन्न cut, (cloth, &c.) and वे to sew, affix अण्.

f. (-नी)
A suture of the skull.
E.
तुन्न cut, and सेवनी a suture.

f. (-नी)
Sharp pain in the perinœum and lower part of the abdomen.
